Visual robot cell configurator — built from zero so any prospect can configure independently

Coboworx sells robotic automation cells to SMEs — buyers who often don’t have deep robotics expertise. They needed a configurator anyone could use to explore a valid configuration, understand pricing, and generate a quote-ready spec. No off-the-shelf tool fit the product’s logic.

We built a fully interactive robot cell configurator with a visual interface, compatibility rules, and pricing output. Customers explore configurations independently — the tool enforces technical constraints behind the scenes, so every output is valid for sales. The configurator became Coboworx’s primary commercial tool.
